title: TV
description: SVT's live channels, or a stream of your own, in a card.
help: Give this module a screen position of its own (for example bottom right): the picture stays where the card was when it started, so it doesn't follow a card that other cards push around.

source.title: Channel
source.description: What to play: a ready-made channel, or one of your own sources.
source.help: Your own sources are in the list below (save a new source first, then choose it here). SVT only shows its channels in Sweden. Renamed or removed a source? Choose again here. It plays whenever the module is enabled and shown: its schedule and Privacy Mode stop it.

own_sources.title: Your own sources
own_sources.description: Streams you add yourself; they show up in the Channel list above.
own_sources.help: An HLS (.m3u8) or MP4 address, on the internet or on your home network (a NAS, a camera). Home-network addresses need MirrorDash 0.18.

output.title: Speakers
output.description: Where the sound goes. The screen only if it has speakers: one without them stays silent.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: How loud, as it sounds (0-100). The Settings tab's volume sets the whole mirror's.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Cover the whole screen with the picture. No other card can be seen meanwhile.
